# Contract reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/contract-reference.mjs from deployments/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every deployed contract: its address on each network, every function and who can call it, its events
and its errors. Each page matches the ABI deployed at that address. How the contracts work together is in
[Protocol](../README.md).

**Who can call** gives each function's access modifier. "Checked inside the function" means the
function tests its caller in its body; the linked source has the rule. Which account holds each role is
on-chain state: see [Governance](../../governance/README.md).
